Writing Functions
================

``` r
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
```

``` r
library(readxl)
```

## Functions!

Start small with Z scores.

``` r
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

    ##  [1]  0.263654571 -1.221128756 -1.493777040  1.138358140  1.251513041
    ##  [6]  2.281413650 -0.100771787 -0.373812992  0.120506838 -1.191746279
    ## [11]  1.857602269  1.828341907 -0.604111767  0.840575149 -0.891424252
    ## [16]  0.561103243 -0.051646483  0.529363871  0.020154577  0.436427674
    ## [21] -1.613947435 -1.087748995 -1.162688098  1.128336423 -1.216913210
    ## [26]  0.271841512 -0.360843370  1.015125009 -0.217290952 -0.918080194
    ## [31]  0.016606384  0.009340461  0.228905681  0.721515528 -1.331981449
    ## [36] -0.022588173  0.177416096  0.422499784 -1.799989665  0.539889088

Let’s turn this into a function

``` r
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if (!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
  
  return(z)
  
}
```

Does this actually work???

``` r
z_scores(x_vec)
```

``` r
source("source/nsduh_process.R")
```
